song: 70 - Kid Cudi - Pursuit of Happiness [Remix Steve Aoki] (lyrics)
title: relampago strikes the bar, the drop crowns
story: Kid Cudi, Pursuit of Happiness (Steve Aoki) at 129 BPM: the build runs four bars, each opening on a downbeat strike (onsets 8.5 at 3576, 16.6 at 3643, 17.9 at 3704, 12.3 at 3764) while the shake climbs bar by bar. The drop at 3812 (rms 0.098 to 0.20, +3.1 sd) releases the shake and opens a six-fold crown with the strikes on every beat, the hue steps and the contrast opens. The post-roll settles into strikes on 1 and 3, fire on the snares, a crown every two bars and a background tint drift each bar of the steady groove.
